notes.title: Bungite Update 18.93 - Where yo Bung at
notes.content:
Update 18.93
-Frame rate limit added, should improve performance, if not then cry about it.
-The storng bazarr has had some bards take up residence, give them a visit

notes.title: Debating Music Update
notes.content: Silence. Darkness. The void. Hither a single note from the aether. The silence is fulfilled by the graceful sounds of a Bungite in the distance. Hear their cries in the Disputation Chamber.
